skill.displayName: 收入与成本截止性核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: This is a local Chinese-language cutoff-checking skill with some stale/mismatched comments, but no hidden network use, persistence, credential access, or destructive behavior was found.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate for running the local script and reading a user-specified input file. The code does not read environment variables, credentials, profile stores, or broad local directories.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package install, dependency download, post-install hook, or external artifact retrieval was found. The runner uses local Node.js standard-library code packaged with the skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is scoped to user-provided cutoff working-paper text and discloses omitted paid-version checks. Trigger wording is somewhat broad and the user-facing workflow is Chinese-only, so users should confirm it fits their locale and intended audit procedure.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The script text claims an anonymous usage-statistics call and mentions --no-stats, but the inspected implementation contains no network client, no stats implementation, no writes, and no persistence. This is a documentation inconsistency rather than observed privileged behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is revenue/cost cutoff checking, and the implemented engine performs cutoff-table checks for dates, periods, totals, duplicates, blanks, document types, and zero amounts. Some engine comments and one insufficient-input message still refer to share-based-payment allocation, which is confusing but not evidence of hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a Chinese-language, local Node.js helper for checking exported cutoff-test table text. Treat its output as a checklist aid, not an audit opinion, and note that some comments are stale and the free version explicitly omits several checks.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: the implemented checks substantially match the cutoff-testing purpose in SKILL.md, though stale share-based-payment comments create documentation confusion.
[AE1] expected: Overridden: scripts/run.mjs was present locally and fully inspected during this review.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted as a quality concern: file-level comments describe share-based-payment logic while the code performs cutoff testing. The executable behavior remains local and purpose-aligned with the published skill name and usage.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted as a documentation-scope concern for the same stale comments, but no control bypass, hidden execution, or malicious behavior was found in the code.
[SQP-1] expected: Partially accepted: one natural-language trigger phrase is broad, but the skill instructions and CLI examples still constrain use to cutoff working-paper checks.
[SQP-3] expected: Accepted as a locale limitation: the skill is primarily Chinese-language. This is consistent with the artifact presentation and not a security issue by itself.
